summary: Completed comprehensive testing of customer management feature for Supreme Detail Studio admin dashboard. Backend APIs are 100% functional with full CRUD operations, search, import/export CSV, and auto-customer creation. Frontend customer management interface is 95% functional with successful customer list display, add/edit forms, view details modal, search functionality, and CSV import/export operations.

ui_bugs.issue: X close button selector difficult to target with specific CSS selectors
ui_bugs.workaround: Modal can be closed by clicking overlay area

passed_tests: Backend customer CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) all functional
Customer search by name, email, and phone working correctly
CSV export functionality returning proper file download
CSV import functionality processing data correctly
Auto-customer creation on booking submission working
Customer matching by email AND phone as specified
Admin login and navigation to Customers page successful
Customer list displays with proper table structure and data
Add new customer modal opens and saves data correctly
Edit customer modal pre-fills data and updates successfully
Customer details view modal shows stats, contact info, and booking history
Search functionality filters results by name, email, and phone
Customer table shows all required columns (name, contact, bookings, total spent, last visit, tags)
Import modal accepts CSV data and processes it correctly
Export button initiates CSV download successfully
Customer stats calculation (total bookings, total spent, last visit) working
Customer booking history retrieval and display working
Modal overlay click closes modals properly
